command: tools/with-env uv run -q pytest -q -m md tests/destination
machine_note: 10 cores, 16 GB, shared with up to three other workers of the same build (their tests, Postgres clusters and JVMs may have been running); times are indications only

conflict_in_a_statement.text: Conflict: lane control: write-write conflict in a statement
conflict_in_a_statement.what: two lanes of one epoch; the second updates a row the first has updated and not committed

interrupted_between_fence_and_commit.text: CommitUnknown: lane stream: the outcome of COMMIT is unknown (TransactionException: TransactionContext Error: Failed to commit: MotherDuck transaction statement failed: Connection Error: interrupted by user)
interrupted_between_fence_and_commit.what: the lane transaction stands before COMMIT (fault site md.commit blocks), its server connection is interrupted, then COMMIT is sent

lost_connection_at_md.commit.what: fault site md.commit raises ConnectionError once inside a lane transaction with one UPDATE

lost_connection_at_md.commit_reply.what: fault site md.commit_reply raises ConnectionError once inside a lane transaction with one UPDATE

lost_connection_at_md.execute.what: fault site md.execute raises ConnectionError once inside a lane transaction with one UPDATE

lost_connection_at_md.fence.what: fault site md.fence raises ConnectionError once inside a lane transaction with one UPDATE

open_transaction_interrupted_then_leave_.text: ConnectionLost: lane stream: connection lost during the fence statement: TransactionException: TransactionContext Error: transaction already rolled back: Connection Error: interrupted by user
open_transaction_interrupted_then_leave_.what: a lane transaction that has run one UPDATE; its server connection is interrupted; then the block ends (the fence statement)

open_transaction_interrupted_then_statem.text: ConnectionLost: lane stream: connection lost during a statement: TransactionException: TransactionContext Error: transaction already rolled back: Connection Error: interrupted by user
open_transaction_interrupted_then_statem.what: a lane transaction that has run one UPDATE; its server connection is interrupted; then the block runs another statement

client_interrupt_while_the_statement_run.sql: an UPDATE that sleeps 4 s on the server; interrupt() of the client after 0.8 s

commit_after_a_failed_statement_answers_.outcome: TransactionException: TransactionContext Error: Conflict on update!

idle_open_transaction_interrupted_on_the.outcome: ConnectionException: Connection Error: interrupted by user
TransactionException: TransactionContext Error: transaction already rolled back: Connection Error: interrupted by user
TransactionException: TransactionContext Error: Failed to commit: MotherDuck transaction statement failed: Connection Error: interrupted by user

statement_in_flight_interrupted_on_the_s.outcome: ConnectionException: Connection Error: interrupted by user
statement_in_flight_interrupted_on_the_s.sql: an UPDATE that sleeps 20 s on the server

two_transactions_create_one_table.outcome: TransactionException: TransactionContext Error: Catalog write-write conflict on create with "Schema\0main\0main\0Table\0main\0x"

write_write_conflict_in_a_statement.outcome: TransactionException: TransactionContext Error: Conflict on update!

raw_texts.what: plain client connections a and b to one MotherDuck database; each list is one case, statement by statement; 'class' is what cdc_v2.md.errors.kind_of makes of the error

statement_interrupted_on_the_server.text: ConnectionLost: lane stream: connection lost during a statement: ConnectionException: Connection Error: interrupted by user
statement_interrupted_on_the_server.what: a lane statement that sleeps 20 s on the server; another connection calls md_interrupt_server_connection with the lane connection's id after 1.5 s

what: What MotherDuck and its client raise, and the error of contract C4 the layer turns it into
